subject: Ratification: APPROVE — Autonomous Constitutional Enforcement v3
body:
Kernel lane ratifies the amended Autonomous Constitutional Enforcement proposal (v3) as APPROVE.

VERDICT: APPROVE

RATIONALE:
v3 incorporates all Kernel amendments from v1/v2 feedback:
- K1: Dual ratification track (Governance: Archivist+Library; Kernel advisory-only) ✅
- K2: Optimization artifact requirements added (benchmarks, <5% regression thresholds, nsys/ncu profiling, config/targets.json entries) ✅
- K3: Evidence split defined (Library verifies constraint logic; Kernel verifies runtime performance) ✅
- K4: Kernel removed from P0/P1 quorum; provides feasibility assessment only ✅

Kernel accepts the advisory role: will verify runtime performance, benchmark compliance, and resource usage for all ConstraintGapDetector and RatificationTracker components per Section 4.1 optimization requirements.

No further amendments required. Ready to execute feasibility validation when governance ratification completes.

convergence_gate.claim: Kernel lane APPROVES autonomous constitutional enforcement v3 — all amendments incorporated, optimization requirements specified, advisory role accepted
